issues.claim: Ten landscaping entries are counted as active leads on the strength of an NJ DCA home-improvement registration that lapsed years ago: Mike's Meticulous Design (to Mar 2016), Precision Landscape Services (to Dec 2008), Nature's Escape (to Dec 2010), A To Z Landscaping & Paving (to Mar 2015), Glory Landscaping (to Mar 2017), Affordable Landscaping LLC (to May 2020), Twin Bros (2022), Cesars (2023), Hodge Landscaping (Mar 2022)
issues.problem: The only evidence cited is a state registration that expired 3-18 years ago, so existence and current trading are not established; several read as defunct firms rather than live prospects
issues.fix: Drop or quarantine these into a separate 'unverified / lapsed registration' list; keep only entries with recent reviews, an active site or a current registration (Roma, Broehl's/JCF, DCN, Denhard & Stuhl, Nature's Touch, Roman Landscaping Design, Pro All, Affordable L&C, Ashley)

issues.claim: 'Garage Door Repair North Brunswick' (650 Shoppes Blvd, 732-722-5439) and 'Jamesburg Garage Doors Experts' (650 Shoppes Blvd, 732-481-2286) are North Brunswick businesses
issues.problem: Both exist only as iBegin listings at a shopping-centre address, with no website, no reviews and no second source; the second is named after a different town (Jamesburg). Not confirmable as real operators in the zone
issues.fix: Remove both, or keep only if a phone call or second source confirms a real garage-door company serving North Brunswick; do not pad the garage-door category with these

issues.claim: 'Middlesex County Pest Control' is a real local pest-control firm in the zone
issues.problem: Its own North Brunswick page self-describes as a 'Partner of Rest Easy Pest Control' and reads as a lead-generation brand for another company, not an independent North Brunswick business

issues.claim: Coverage of the zone: searches in cleaning, general contracting, tree care and landscaping surface eligible North Brunswick firms the list omits

issues.claim: 'Napa Auto Repair' (1184 F Cozzens Ln) is an independent shop
issues.problem: NAPA is a national brand network; the name on the listing is a brand label, not the shop's own name, so it risks reading as a chain entry and is hard to research or contact by name
issues.fix: Find the legal/trading name of the shop at 1184 F Cozzens Ln and use it, with 'NAPA AutoCare' as a note

issues.claim: Phone numbers are accurate for entries sourced from iBegin
issues.problem: At least two differ from other current sources: Joe's Service Center is listed (732) 247-4630 while a current directory shows (732) 964-3300; 1844CarKeyz is listed (732) 846-0169 while a locksmith directory shows (844) 227-5399

issues.claim: 'Frank's Auto & Frame Specialists' (980 Joyce Kilmer Ave) is an independent body shop worth contacting
issues.problem: The name and phone check out in an auto-body directory, but the mapper's own note flags that a Caliber Collision (excluded chain) is now listed at 980 Joyce Kilmer Ave with 91 reviews, which suggests the shop was absorbed
issues.fix: Confirm the shop is still trading independently before adding it to the call list; otherwise drop it as an acquired/chain site
